sources.title: Google Street View
sources.note: August 2025 panorama inspected October 8, 2026. An old wooden two-storey house behind a stone wall and mature trees stands on the north corner. It is the only old house at the junction: the east corner is under construction, the south corner holds a shop and a modern bank building, and the west corner a modern commercial block. Capture dates are not construction dates. No image is saved or distributed.
